text: The purpose of this report is to provide the current sale and long term lease policy for the Board's approval. The policy describes Board approvals required for property sales and leases and the information to be included in reports to the Board.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved the Property Sale and Lease Policy attached to the report (March 6, 2018) from the Head, Development, CreateTO. 2. Directed the Transition Lead, CreateTO to consult and work with the City of Toronto Energy and Environment Division, to review options for CreateTO's Property Sale and Lease Policy to include opportunities to achieve the City's CO2 reduction targets while generating new revenue streams from energy and environment initiatives.
